assessments.reasoning: The Fifth Edition requires processing equivalent to replacing a literal CRLF pair or an unpaired CR with one LF on input to parsing an external parsed entity, including the document entity. The attribute-value rule separately illustrates the later interpretation of a character reference.

challenge.method: Compare a literal CRLF with a numeric reference to CR in an attribute, and check whether a distinct normalization pass is mandatory.
challenge.results: The literal pair contributes one LF at the input stage. The reference contributes its designated CR during attribute-value processing. The specification requires equivalent behavior and leaves the processor's internal staging open.

limitations: The specification includes the document entity. Character references are interpreted later.
The proposition covers the input treatment for external parsed entities. It does not specify the outcome of later attribute processing.
